results.title: Denounce jihadist massacre with 48 civilians in Mali | Demócrata
results.snippet:
A civil entity representing Berber tribes from eastern Mali has reported that at least 48 civilians were killed last weekend in a massacre attributed to the branch of the jihadist organization Islamic State in the Sahel, known as Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (EIGS). [...] Follow us
